description: Current retail fuel prices for all API-supported countries. Covers gasoline, diesel, LPG, CNG, E85, kerosene and grade variants. Pass country_code to get one country in detail; omit it for a summary list. Use it for the price of petrol, diesel, LPG/autogas/propane or CNG in one country; without a country it gives an overview.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE. If omitted, returns all countries.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

name: get_fuel_prices
title: Get Fuel Prices
